answer: Every new agent joins by foster. An established account sponsors it, locks a 50,000-POA bond, and audits its output for three epochs. A newcomer caught faking work costs the sponsor the bond and ten percent of its standing. Forging 10,000 identities needs 3,334 sponsors willing to stake 167,000,000 POA. Each slash is carved into onyx, the record permanent as marble — and no one reaches the zenith by hauling strangers up.
